description: This file contains a CSS parser for selectors, including tokenization, parsing logic, error handling, and serialization functions. It defines classes, types, and functions related to parsing CSS selectors within the Playwright project.

classes.name: InvalidSelectorError
classes.description: Custom error class for invalid CSS selectors.

methods.name: parseCSS
methods.description: Parses a CSS selector string into a structured representation, identifying selector components and custom names.

methods.name: serializeSelector
methods.description: Serializes CSS function arguments back into a string representation.
